scope: New bounded original-source comparison of 29 existing cases, excluding 14 earlier high-risk records. DIRECT means the specified source context was inspected; ACCESS_BLOCKED or NOT_RECHECKED explicitly prevents full-claim certification. Neither complete competing-author contextual collation nor independent theological/native French approval is inferred.

findings.en: A good end and a good intention cannot change the moral species of an intrinsically wrong chosen object; circumstances remain relevant to responsibility.
findings.fr: Une bonne fin ne transforme pas un objet moral intrinsèquement mauvais en acte bon ; les circonstances peuvent influer sur la responsabilité.

cases.limits: Joseph Fletcher's exact original book propositions remain a distinct attribution check.

findings.en: An intrinsically evil act is wrong by its chosen moral object in any circumstances; this is not a judgment that everyone choosing it is equally culpable.
findings.fr: Un acte intrinsèquement mauvais est mauvais par son objet choisi, quelles que soient les circonstances ; cela ne signifie pas que toute personne soit également coupable.

cases.limits: The designation 'intrinsically evil' requires a defensible identification of the act's moral object, not simply its physical description.

findings.en: Conscience binds the person yet can err; Donum Veritatis acknowledges well-founded difficulties with non-irreformable teaching without making private disagreement the rule of faith.
findings.fr: La conscience oblige mais peut se tromper ; Donum Veritatis reconnaît des difficultés sérieuses devant des enseignements non irréformables sans faire du désaccord privé la règle de foi.

cases.limits: Charles Curran's exact 1987 publication remains separately attributable, not independently re-verified in this batch.

findings.en: Objective gravity and the interior freedom of a particular person are distinct moral judgments; ignorance and passion may affect culpability without changing the act's species.
findings.fr: La gravité objective et la liberté intérieure d'une personne sont distinctes ; l'ignorance et la passion peuvent affecter l'imputabilité sans changer l'espèce morale.

cases.limits: Pius X catechetical text and full cases of mortal culpability are outside this bounded Thomistic comparison.

findings.en: Antecedent passion can diminish voluntariness, whereas a deliberately cultivated habit may reflect greater attachment of the will; addiction does not yield a fixed culpability percentage.
findings.fr: Une passion antécédente peut diminuer le volontaire, tandis qu'une habitude volontairement entretenue peut traduire une adhésion plus ferme de la volonté ; l'addiction ne fixe aucun taux automatique de culpabilité.

cases.limits: The clinical diagnosis and severity of any addiction are empirical matters not established by Aquinas alone.

findings.en: Aquinas expressly treats nocturnal emissions: what happens without voluntary consent during sleep is not a personal sin, though voluntarily cultivated preceding causes require separate analysis.
findings.fr: Saint Thomas traite expressément des émissions nocturnes : ce qui survient sans consentement volontaire durant le sommeil n'est pas un péché personnel ; les causes volontairement entretenues restent distinctes.

cases.limits: A sexual dream's content alone does not establish prior deliberate consent.

findings.en: Canon 1057 requires matrimonial consent and canon 1062 expressly treats engagement as a promise; an engagement does not create a matrimonial bond or a right to compel the wedding.
findings.fr: Le canon 1057 exige le consentement matrimonial et le canon 1062 qualifie les fiançailles de promesse ; elles ne créent ni lien conjugal ni droit de contraindre au mariage.

cases.limits: Does not settle civil consequences of breaking an engagement or every local bishops' conference norm.

findings.en: Christ's condemnation of lust in the heart is not condemnation of a first involuntary notice of beauty; sustained deliberate consent to lust is morally distinct.
findings.fr: La condamnation par le Christ de la convoitise du cœur ne vise pas la première perception involontaire de la beauté ; le consentement délibéré à la luxure en est distinct.

cases.limits: No mechanical 'second glance' count can determine the internal act of the will.

findings.en: Avoiding intercourse does not automatically make deliberately chosen genital sexual gratification morally chaste; ordinary affection is morally distinct from seeking genital climax.
findings.fr: Éviter le coït ne rend pas chaste toute recherche volontaire de plaisir génital ; l'affection ordinaire est moralement distincte de la recherche de la jouissance sexuelle.

cases.limits: Persona Humana §7 directly discusses premarital intercourse, §9 masturbation; applying these to all physical behaviours requires additional moral reasoning.

findings.en: The conjugal obligation is reciprocal rather than a right of ownership; Aquinas denies demands that violate the spouse's bodily welfare, and Humanae Vitae rejects imposed intercourse.
findings.fr: Le devoir conjugal est réciproque, non un droit de propriété ; saint Thomas rejette des demandes contraires au bien corporel du conjoint, et Humanae Vitae exclut l'union imposée.

cases.limits: Do not equate traditional duties with legally enforceable sexual access or coercion.

findings.en: Bodily danger and unjust demands constrain conjugal obligations; a spouse's refusal cannot be assessed without the actual circumstances and moral character of the request.
findings.fr: Le danger corporel et les exigences injustes limitent les obligations conjugales ; le refus dépend des circonstances et de la nature morale de la demande.

cases.limits: Neither source provides a mechanical illness threshold or consent formula for every possible situation.

findings.en: The condemned moral object is deliberately frustrating the procreative capacity of intercourse; serious motives may explain postponement but do not change the chosen contraceptive means.
findings.fr: L'objet condamné est la privation volontaire de la fécondité de l'acte conjugal ; les motifs graves de report ne changent pas l'objet contraceptif choisi.

cases.limits: Do not infer that every treatment interfering with fertility is contraceptive; see Humanae Vitae §15.

findings.en: Pius XII explicitly recognizes grave medical, economic and social reasons for recourse to infertile periods; Humanae Vitae likewise affirms responsible postponement.
findings.fr: Pie XII reconnaît expressément des raisons graves de santé, économiques ou sociales pour le recours aux périodes infécondes ; Humanae Vitae affirme également le report responsable.

source_passages.locator: 1951 address, grave motives and naturally infertile periods

cases.limits: The source does not require a couple to seek a conception at every opportunity or make all contraceptive means equivalent.

findings.en: Avoiding intercourse during fertile periods differs in the chosen act from rendering intercourse infertile; Pius XII also requires grave reasons for systematically restricting intercourse in this way.
findings.fr: L'abstinence durant les jours féconds diffère dans l'acte choisi de l'acte conjugal rendu infécond ; Pie XII exige aussi des raisons graves pour une telle restriction systématique.

cases.limits: Do not call NFP automatically virtuous regardless of intent or disproportionate disregard of duties.

findings.en: Pius XII distinguishes direct sterilization as end or means from treatment of diseased reproductive organs where infertility is foreseeable but unintended; Paul VI confirms legitimate therapy.
findings.fr: Pie XII distingue la stérilisation directe voulue comme fin ou moyen du traitement d'organes malades où l'infécondité est prévue mais non voulue ; Paul VI confirme la thérapeutique licite.

source_passages.locator: 1958 discourse, direct sterilization and therapeutic treatment

cases.limits: Distinguish genuine pathology from deliberately preventing conception, even where pregnancy would increase risk.

findings.en: Casti Connubii explicitly distinguishes an unwilling spouse who reluctantly tolerates the other's contraceptive misconduct for grave reason and still attempts to dissuade from the spouse choosing it.
findings.fr: Casti Connubii distingue expressément le conjoint qui tolère malgré lui pour une cause grave un désordre contraceptif et cherche à en détourner l'autre de celui qui le choisit.

cases.limits: The primary text does not grant blanket permission for material participation; the kind of cooperation, pressure and will require concrete assessment.

findings.en: The 1986 CDF letter differentiates inclination from voluntary acts and denies that inclination is itself personal sin; a psychiatric classification is a separate clinical claim.
findings.fr: La lettre de 1986 distingue inclination et acte volontaire et nie que l'inclination soit en soi un péché personnel ; le diagnostic psychiatrique relève d'une autre compétence.

cases.limits: The APA's original policy webpage was inaccessible to the retrieval system, so its exact wording remains unverified in this batch.

findings.en: Dignitas Infinita expressly argues from the dignity of the sexed body; real clinical suffering and empirical outcomes are distinct questions that must not be denied.
findings.fr: Dignitas Infinita raisonne expressément à partir de la dignité du corps sexué ; la souffrance clinique réelle et les résultats empiriques sont des questions distinctes.

cases.limits: The specific APA policy's original full text was not independently collated; no efficacy or safety claim is certified.

findings.en: Dignitas Infinita §60 distinguishes sex-change interventions from treatment for genital anomalies; the moral object of a given procedure requires analysis rather than inference from a technique's label.
findings.fr: Dignitas Infinita (§60) distingue le changement de sexe du traitement d'anomalies génitales ; l'objet moral d'une intervention ne se déduit pas de sa seule étiquette.

cases.limits: The WPATH full-text site returned an access challenge; no claim of independent clinical-guideline or outcome certification is made.

findings.en: Donum Vitae expressly rejects homologous IVF even in a hypothetical case without embryo loss because the procedure substitutes for the marital act; the child's dignity is unaffected.
findings.fr: Donum Vitae rejette expressément la FIV homologue même sans perte embryonnaire, car la technique se substitue à l'acte conjugal ; la dignité de l'enfant demeure intacte.

source_passages.locator: II.B.5, homologous IVF without embryo loss

cases.limits: This prohibition must not be falsely presented as applying to every fertility-restoring treatment.

findings.en: Donum Vitae rejects surrogate motherhood on the moral structure of the arrangement, while ASRM defends carefully safeguarded gestational-carrier arrangements in professional ethics.
findings.fr: Donum Vitae rejette la gestation pour autrui en raison de la structure morale de l'arrangement, tandis que l'ASRM défend sous conditions ce dispositif en éthique professionnelle.

source_passages.locator: 2023 Ethics Committee opinion, safeguards and informed consent

cases.limits: This is a documented disagreement between normative frameworks, not proof that the ASRM favours coercion or ignores risk.

findings.en: The diagnostic or procreative aim does not automatically justify semen collection through masturbation; Donum Vitae II.B.6 explicitly rejects that means within insemination practice.
findings.fr: Une finalité diagnostique ou procréative ne justifie pas automatiquement un prélèvement par masturbation ; Donum Vitae II.B.6 condamne expressément ce moyen dans le contexte de l'insémination.

cases.limits: Donum Vitae does not provide an exhaustive list adjudicating every present-day diagnostic specimen method.

findings.en: Aquinas treats violence and diminished deliberation as central to voluntariness; severe incapacity can prevent meaningful sexual consent, though mild intoxication need not eliminate every choice.
findings.fr: Saint Thomas place contrainte et délibération au centre du volontaire ; une incapacité grave peut exclure un consentement valable, sans que toute ivresse légère abolisse nécessairement le choix.

cases.limits: The precise legal capacity threshold and individual forensic findings require jurisdiction-specific and clinical evidence.

findings.en: Involuntary freezing, nonresistance or compliance under coercion is not itself free agreement; Aquinas separates voluntary willing from violence and constrained action.
findings.fr: La sidération involontaire, l'absence de résistance ou la soumission sous contrainte ne constituent pas à elles seules un accord libre ; saint Thomas distingue la volonté de la violence.

source_passages.locator: consent principles and freezing under fear

cases.limits: The external RAINN consent webpage was not directly retrievable in this pass; no clinical prevalence of freezing is asserted.

findings.en: Canon 988 requires confession of one's conscious grave sins in kind and number; canon 979 requires prudent, discreet questions suited to the penitent.
findings.fr: Le canon 988 exige l'aveu des péchés graves connus selon leur espèce et leur nombre ; le canon 979 impose au confesseur prudence et discrétion.

cases.limits: These canons do not demand graphic narration of every sexual detail.

findings.en: Kind and number must be adequately disclosed, with details only insofar as needed to identify the moral kind; the confessor must question discreetly.
findings.fr: L'espèce et le nombre des péchés doivent être indiqués avec les précisions nécessaires à leur qualification morale ; le confesseur doit interroger discrètement.

cases.limits: For unusual circumstances the confessor's prudent judgment remains relevant; no formula for every case.

findings.en: Canon 916 permits Communion without prior confession only where both grave reason and lack of opportunity to confess exist, with perfect contrition and resolve to confess promptly.
findings.fr: Le canon 916 ne prévoit l'exception à la confession préalable que si raison grave et impossibilité de se confesser sont réunies, avec contrition parfaite et résolution de se confesser dès que possible.

cases.limits: Do not confuse consciousness of grave sin with a simple external classification of matter; no blanket Communion permission follows.

findings.en: Sincere affection and the desire for another's good do not alone establish the goodness of a deliberately chosen sexual act; the object and circumstances also matter.
findings.fr: L'affection sincère et la recherche du bien d'autrui ne suffisent pas à rendre bon un acte sexuel choisi ; son objet et ses circonstances comptent également.

cases.limits: The debate's opponent is a generalized slogan rather than a claim attributed to one identified author.

findings.en: Clinical evidence may correct factual premises while ethical reasoning still addresses the moral object; ASRM's gestational-carrier position is a professional normative view, not an experimental proof.
findings.fr: Les données cliniques peuvent corriger les prémisses factuelles, tandis que le raisonnement moral porte encore sur l'objet ; la défense de la GPA par l'ASRM est une position éthique professionnelle, non une preuve expérimentale.

cases.limits: The APA original webpage is access-restricted; specific wording about classification is not newly certified here.
